ops-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT 00:12 UTC - hosted-infer gateway p99 latency spike + 5xx increase. SLO burn 15m window exceeded. probe=ingress-probe-us-west2, affected routes: /v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream. ticket: https://support.redwood.example/t/INC-4821
Maria: seeing it, joining. do we have a customer impact list?
Sam: support says ~8 customers reported 502/504s, a couple mention auth failures turning into 5xx. their logs show `500` on our gateway.
Jordan: quick top-level checks: Grafana panel shows big jump at 00:10. Query I ran: `sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway", status=~"5.."}[1m])) by (route)` shows /v1/generate at 18rps 5xx.
Leo: posting dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/hosted-infer-ingress?from=now-30m&to=now
Anya: any change in sampling or trace retention? traces look sparse right when the spike started. many traces missing x-trace-id header.
Maria: log slice for one failed request (from ingress logs):
```
ts=2025-11-02T00:10:23Z level=error route=/v1/generate req_id=abc123 upstream=authz service_error="authz: tokenValidation failed: upstream 502" duration_ms=12003 status=500
```
Sam: interesting - upstream authz call returned 502 which we turned into 500. Which upstream is that exactly? billing/authz-service?
Jordan: yes, authz-service (internal: authz-main.us-west2). I see elevated 502s in its dashboard. Query: `rate(upstream_response_codes_total{service="authz-main", code="502"}[1m])`
Leo: I pulled the authz logs, there's a pattern `kms: get-key failed: 503 Service Unavailable`. Looks like KMS decryption timed out and authz returned 502.
Anya: that would short-circuit policy: gateway waits synchronously on authz call for token policy check. If authz is slow, gateway timeouts escalate into client 504/502. Can we confirm timeouts?
Maria: From gateway traces: many spans end with `upstream_timeout` and no full trace propagated. sampling looks like traces-heavy drop at same minute.
Sam: repro attempt for a failing request (sanitized) — send with a valid API key:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <api_key>" https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
response: 500, body: `{ "error": "internal_error", "code": 500 }`
Jordan: I did a controlled test toggling a flag to bypass authz (test cluster only) and requests succeeded immediately, p99 back to normal. So authz is the choke.
Leo: root cause candidate: KMS region had transient throttling causing authz to fail on key decrypts. KMS errors turned into 502 from authz which gateway returned as 500. Also trace sampling dropped because authz logs suppressed headers when erroring.
Anya: mitigation options: 1) temporary fallback: let gateway accept tokens validated by cached policy for 30s TTL; 2) route authz calls to standby authz-instance in eu-west; 3) increase authz timeout to avoid churn? Pros/cons?
Maria: immediate action: enable policy cache fallback (low-risk) and expand authz timeout to 5s from 2s for 5m. Jordan, can you toggle cache fallback?
Jordan: doing it now in prod feature-flags: `authz.cache_fallback=true` -> applied. Confirming traffic.
Sam: after toggle, 5xx rate dropped to baseline in ~45s. Graph: p99 down from 6.2s to 380ms.
Leo: creating a short-lived runbook entry for this flow. note: authz -> KMS dependency needs a resilience pattern (circuit breaker + async validation).
Anya: follow-up: need to add synthetic trace that includes full header propagation to detect trace-gap earlier. Also add alert rule for upstream 5xx ratio + missing trace headers.
Maria: I'll open an incident ticket and notify on-call KMS/infra teams. ACTIONS:
- Maria: incident ticket and customer comms (INC-4821)
- Jordan: postmortem draft + runbook update (due EOD)
- Leo: coordinate with KMS infra for throttling root cause (investigate quota, cascading retries)
- Sam: add Grafana alert rule: `sum without(instance)(rate(http_requests_total{job="gateway",status=~"5.."}[5m])) > 5` and another on `sum(rate(app_request_missing_trace_header[5m])) > 1`
- Anya: create synthetic trace test that fires every 5m with full headers

Maria: FYI customer escalation: support will send an interim note explaining degraded API availability and we've implemented fallback. ask: do we need credit adjustments? billing team to advise.
Jordan: quick note about permanent fix: move KMS decrypt to async path in authz (return JWT-like short-lived token to gateway) so gateway doesn't block on KMS in the hot path. adding to roadmap.
Sam: tagging @kms-infra and @platform-quotas for follow up.
ops-bot: Incident INC-4821 created by Maria at 00:22 UTC. https://incidents.redwood.example/INC-4821
Maria: thank you all. will keep updates here. :thumbsup:
